---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, new microscopy format, or analysis metric for Riji
title: '[ENHANCEMENT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Scientific / Practical Motivation**
Is your feature request related to a problem or new experimental setup? Please describe (e.g. "I am acquiring 4-channel live-cell time-lapse on a Leica SP8...").

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Alternative Approaches Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered (e.g. ImageJ / Fiji macros, CellProfiler pipelines).

**Citations / References**
If this involves a published algorithm or colocalization formula, please provide the DOI, paper title, or paper link.
